pages.text: Naomi's family had a very sad time, and she wanted to go home to Bethlehem. Her daughter-in-law Ruth said, "Where you go, I will go."
In Bethlehem they were hungry. Ruth went to a barley field to pick up leftover grain. The field belonged to a kind man named Boaz.
Boaz saw how kind Ruth was to Naomi. He gave her extra food and made sure she was safe in his fields.
Later, Ruth and Boaz were married, and Naomi was happy again. Ruth's great-grandson was King David. One day, Jesus would be born in David's family.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Ruth was loyal and kind to Naomi, even when it was hard. Jesus teaches us to love others the same way.
